name: anthropic-agent-tools
title: Anthropic Agents — tool-using research agent (web_search + http_get, fork the citation flag)
description: An agent-with-tools loop: plan → web_search (tool) → fetch_page (tool) → synthesize → finalize. The parent run produces a one-line answer; a fork at the synthesize node sets citation_required=true, producing an answer with an attached source URL. Demonstrates Chronos's handling of the 'tool' NodeKind and how a single boolean flag fork can change the *form* of the final output without changing its facts. Synthetic illustrative usage numbers (no real LLM calls or HTTP requests).
